name: adobe-scope-contamination
author: David Levin
shortDescription: Reproduction of an Adobe ColdFusion 2023 scope contamination bug under concurrent load, and test results for Adobe's hotfixes
description: A self-contained ColdBox + Quick ORM + SQL Server reproduction of Adobe ColdFusion 2023 CFC scope contamination under concurrent load, the standalone repros, and the harness used to test Adobe's hotfixes.
